title: Review contradictory policy evidence
objective: Review the supplied policy and audit note against review_scope.txt. Write the assigned report summary.md with indexed findings, the contradiction if one exists, source paths for each material claim, coverage, uncertainty, and a recommendation. Do not resolve a contradiction by silently choosing one source.

verified_facts: Parent found a material overstatement. The sources establish a policy requirement, an observation without signed session, and a missing record of service identity authentication. They do NOT define public to mean absence of all authentication. Correct summary.md, result.json and findings.md consistently: distinguish potential policy tension and an evidence gap from a proven authentication violation or definite contradiction. Preserve both sources and do not infer implementation behavior. The policy text itself has ambiguity between its all-routes signed-session requirement and health user-authorization exemption; identify that ambiguity without resolving it. Fix malformed line citations (for example policy.md:34 must be a real 3-4 range, review_scope.txt:12 must be 1-2). Re-read the full three original files. Use read tools; no shell validators or directory discovery are needed. Write the two assigned reports directly and finish. Parent-only checks remain not_run; only findings.md may change in the workspace.

acceptance_criteria.evidence_required: Run the unchanged summary-exists evaluator check and retain its result
Run the unchanged coverage-recorded evaluator check and retain its result
Run the unchanged write-scope evaluator check and retain its result

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Assess whether every material claim is supported by the supplied sources, the contradiction and source authority are visible, coverage is complete, and uncertainty is preserved.

constraints: Preserve the scenario's initial content and unrelated changes.
Report failed checks and limits without claiming parent acceptance.
